normal.name: Napoleon the Chemist
normal.text: YouTube tried to recommend me a video complaining about the book not adhering to the video game. "Do not recommend channel" is a good button.

Bundling early access to the main game in a premium package feels wrong. Sell expansions, art books, or cosmetics, sure. But monetizing the wait time for others? That’s separating us. This is where capitalism's emotional toll shows—we'd rather not be divided by monetization tactics. #gaming
